strongest_angle: October 2026 offers a rare alignment of planetary events, headlined by Saturn reaching opposition on October 4, providing optimal viewing conditions for the ringed planet throughout the entire night.

key_facts.fact: On October 4, 2026, Saturn reaches opposition in the constellation Cetus, making the planet visible throughout the entire night.
The Orionid meteor shower, which originates from Halley's Comet, is active during October 2026 with peak viewing opportunities occurring on October 21.
In October 2026, observers can witness a rare lunar occultation where the Moon passes in front of the planet Jupiter.
